verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: headline, one-line subhead, product inside its peach circle, then the CTA. Its flaws are a tiny 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker crammed against the top edge, a can shrunk too small to read as a product, and legal text under the CTA that is too small to read. B squeezes the subhead into a narrow 4-line stack jammed against '20% off' and sets the legal copy in 4 lines at near-subhead size, so it competes with the message. B also puts the product after the CTA, which breaks the reading order, and leaves the decorative circle as an orphan cropped at the right edge, with text stacks touching the top and bottom edges.
